canonical_project: San Marino National Public Data Center (project)
owner: AASS (Azienda Autonoma di Stato per i Servizi Pubblici) with I.E.S. S.p.A. (Societa Informatica e Servizi Interbancari Sammarinesi) and TIM San Marino technical support
notes: National public data center project: Congress of State (via AASS) commissioned a preliminary feasibility study from I.E.S. S.p.A. (EUR35k) with TIM San Marino technical support; preliminary study presented to stakeholders on 2026-07-10 (San Marino RTV, state broadcaster, A); Congress of State gave a favourable opinion in April 2026 (GiornaleSM/Serenissima Sera, B); AASS acquired I.E.S. (Dec 2025, trade press B) to build a 100% public data center; framed for data sovereignty, PA/banking/private services, part of the San Marino Digital Hub, TIM citing a Tier 4 security target. No site/castello selected, no capacity published - division 'unknown within SM', status planned.
